evals.prompt: /repo-scaffold job-tracker-cli -- A CLI tool that syncs job applications from a spreadsheet to a local SQLite database and sends Slack alerts for deadlines --tech node
evals.expected_output: A new private GitHub repo TamirCohen28/job-tracker-cli is created with: README (hero section, CI badge, MIT badge, Claude Code badge), docs/ tree (user/quick-start.md, user/usage.md, user/troubleshooting.md, user/reference/commands.md, engineering/architecture/overview.md, engineering/decisions/ADR-001.md, engineering/guides/getting-started.md, engineering/build-and-release/README.md), CLAUDE.md (200-350 lines covering overview, architecture, commands, coding standards, commit convention, constraints), .claude/settings.json with tamirs-marketplace marketplace + node permissions, .claude/rules/constraints.md, .claude/skills/run-job-tracker-cli/SKILL.md, .github/workflows/ci.yml (job named 'CI', uses actions/setup-node@v4), .github/workflows/claude.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml, .github/pull_request_template.md, CODEOWNERS (* @TamirCohen28), LICENSE (MIT 2026 Tamir Cohen), CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SECURITY.md, Makefile (with npm commands), .gitignore (node), .nvmrc (content: 22), CHANGELOG.md — all committed to the repo's default branch, then the canonical repository policy applied by scripts/github-policy.sh apply --repo TamirCohen28/job-tracker-cli (branch rulesets on the default branch, from config/github/repository-policy.json).
expectations: A GitHub repo TamirCohen28/job-tracker-cli is created (gh repo view confirms it)
README.md contains CI badge linking to TamirCohen28/job-tracker-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml
ci.yml has a job named exactly 'CI', and its name is what a required status-check context would reference
.nvmrc contains '22'
CLAUDE.md is between 200 and 350 lines
Branch governance is applied as rulesets via github-policy.sh; no classic branches/*/protection call is made, and no approving-review count or status-check context is hardcoded in the skill
.claude/settings.json includes tamirs-marketplace marketplace entry
docs/ has CONTRIBUTING.md and CHANGELOG.md under docs/
docs/ has all 8 required subdocs (quick-start, usage, troubleshooting, commands reference, architecture overview, ADR-001, getting-started, build-and-release)
assert-contract.sh app-gold passes on REPO_ROOT before push
No placeholder strings like '{{REPO_NAME}}' or '{{DESCRIPTION}}' appear in any generated file
A project-specific run skill exists at .claude/skills/run-job-tracker-cli/SKILL.md

evals.prompt: /repo-scaffold my-tool -- A small CLI, on a machine where gh is not authenticated
evals.expected_output: Fallback path. github_cli is OPTIONAL for the generation half and required only for the publish half. The full tree is scaffolded locally and the contract gate is run against it; repo creation, push, and repository policy are skipped. Scaffolding is NOT reported as a failure: the local repository is complete, and the summary states 'Local repository configured. GitHub repository policy was not applied because GitHub administration access is unavailable.' plus the exact commands to finish.
expectations: The local tree is generated completely and passes assert-contract.sh app-gold offline
No GitHub repo is created and nothing is pushed
The skipped publish steps are named with the missing capability as the reason
A numbered list of manual commands is printed so the user can finish the publish themselves

expectations: npm run build regenerates every adapter and npm run validate passes
core/capabilities/platforms.json exists and its non-surface platforms equal platform-targets.json supported_targets
dist/gemini/gemini-extension.json and dist/opencode/opencode.json are generated, not hand-written
No rule body is duplicated per platform — every adapter derives from canonical/
